urls.description: The guide is designed to help solopreneurs prioritize and implement a selection of actions from the NIST Cybersecurity Framework that would best help their businesses.
urls.title: Self-Employed? Solopreneur? NIST Has a Cybersecurity Guide Just for You

data.text:
If you work for yourself, protecting your business from a cyberattack falls entirely on your shoulders. Don’t feel daunted: NIST has just released a guide with your needs — and busy life — in mind. 

Check out our intro to cybersecurity for solopreneurs! https://t.co/Xxb3SIdUMi https://t.co/IAjChSG7vJ
